A **portable power station with solar panels** is a rechargeable battery system that can power devices during camping, RV trips, outdoor activities, or home outages. Solar panels recharge the battery without needing a wall outlet.

For most people, I'd recommend a **LiFePO₄ battery power station with a 100–200W solar panel**, or a larger 200–400W solar setup for home backup.

## What size should you get?

| Use case | Battery capacity | Solar panel |
|---|---|---|
| Phones, laptops, lights | 250–500Wh | 100W |
| Camping, CPAP, small appliances | 500–1,000Wh | 100–200W |
| Mini fridge, longer camping trips | 1,000–2,000Wh | 200–400W |
| Home emergency backup | 2,000Wh+ | 400W+ |

The battery capacity determines how long devices can run; the solar panel wattage determines how quickly you can recharge in sunlight.
